_about: Known motion glitches in films that shipped, for studio/defects.py. Windows are film seconds. kind: through (into or out of a thing across its wall, or cut by its edge), sliver (a body squashed or flipped through flat), double (the same character twice, or a jump with nothing shown), poke (a hidden character's parts showing where they should not), idle (a hand or a shot holding with nothing happening, a beat with only the narrator), untold (narrated, or needed by the story, and not shown), wash (a colour over the whole frame), stray (a line or shape that belongs to nothing), text (words colliding or unreadable). words: what the owner or the rework saw. Three two-minute episodes of one series, each as it first shipped (v1), as it stood between two rounds of fixes (ep8-v2) and as fixed (clean). The film folders are not in the repo.
